fixtureScope: Synthetic admission and timeline metadata exercise runtime gates against actual retained PNG bytes. Fixtures are not asset reviews, original-game idles, or delivered animations.

checks.name: Opaque contexts do not fetch and R29 generated APIs remain unchanged
Index-to-lot SHA binding rejects changed manifests atomically
Bounded index transport refuses an oversized body
Exact static neutral poses draw their actual produced side without claiming animation
Bind poses, context poses, appearance gaps and documentary editions cannot silently become combat
Smooth source scenes remain studies until action and complete-loop proofs are present
Native frame choice follows deterministic combat seconds and never wall clock
Reduced motion freezes native playback while explicit preview seeks remain available
Observed neutral source variants require explicit per-UID opt-in and never certify source semantics
Byte corruption and decoder dimension changes cannot draw a native image
A rolling decoded cache stays bounded and pagehide revokes all blobs
The additive adapter keeps actor/replay state untouched and restores the prior renderer
The adapter honors the existing main-engine reduceMotion spelling as well as reducedMotion
